Encoded video was deinterlaced with QTGMC.

The BD mastering was weird, had to fix a few things during quality checks.

Disc 1 playlist was problematic, it needed remuxing to make it play like
the BD. Also, the 5.1 track needed a -662ms adjustment after remuxing.
Disc 2 was fine and din't require any extra steps.

I included the 2.0 track (no delay adjustment needed), it sounds better
in my opinion, compared to the 5.1 track with its toned down volume!
